Controls:
[font_size=26]In-Game[/font_size]
ESC ({Start}) = Pause
Tab ({Back}) = Toggle Editor
WASD ({Joystick Left}) = Move
Space ({A}) = Jump
Q ({Right Stick Click}) = Crouch
Shift ({Left Stick Click}) = Sprint Speed
E ({Right Shoulder Button}) = Toggle Flashlight
	- (Hold) + Scroll ({DPad Up} + {DPad Down}) = Change Flashlight Size

Ctrl/{X} (Hold) + Scroll ({DPad Up} + {DPad Down}) = Change Camera Zoom
Alt/{Y} (Hold) + Scroll ({DPad Up} + {DPad Down}) = Change Camera Tilt

R (?) = Smooth Out Movement Toggle
	- (Hold) + Scroll = Change Smooth Amount

F ({DPad Left}) = Smooth Out Camera Toggle
	- (Hold) + Scroll = Change Smooth Amount

C (???) = Construction Mode
	Clicking on Construction Mode Items = Open Options
	Selection + Scroll = Change Option
	Option Selected + Scroll = Rotate/Scale
 

V = Fly
	Flying + Q = Descend
	Flying + Space = Ascend

[font_size=26]In-Editor[/font_size]
P = Play/Pause Show (Works In-Game Too)
Shift + Scroll = Pan the Timeline
Ctrl + Scroll = Zoom the Timeline
Scroll = Scroll the Channel List

For each channel, the '[ ]' box on the left can be hovered and a number key (0-9) pressed to assign that key to the channel. Pressing BackSpace deletes that assignment.

When hovering a channel with an assigned key, holding that key and moving the mouse plots out a signal for that channel. You can also hit the play button and press those keys to have them plotted down along with the audio.

Right clicking any plotted signal deletes it. Left click dragging can move the signal. Left lcick dragging the edge of a signal can lengthen/shorten it.
Adding Showtape Media: When creating a new showtape, go to the 'Media' tab on the top left and click the 'Add Media' button. You can import images, video, and audio. The engine will default to the first video/audio it finds in the list as the one that plays. If the imported audio contains an album cover, it will extract that and add it as 'cover.png' which will become the showtape cover. If you want to add your own cover, just rename an image to 'cover.png' or 'cover.jpg' and add it.
